title: Closure under concatenation
statement: Let $f,g$ be polynomial-time computable functions from bit strings to bit strings. Then the function mapping each bit string $x$ to the concatenation $f(x)g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: Let $f$ and $g$ be polynomial-time computable functions on bit strings (each computed by some finite binary Turing machine within $C(n+1)^c$ steps on inputs of length $n$, for some constants $C, c$). Then the map $x \mapsto f(x)\,g(x)$, sending $x$ to the concatenation of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$, is polynomial-time computable.
